<document id=DOC_req_open_enum>
Required: PostgreSQL, Redis or similar databases.
</document>

Using the requirement and the candidate summary above, answer in a numbered list.
1. State what percentage of the requirement the candidate meets.
2. Say whether you matched a named item or judged something equivalent, and if equivalent, name the item it is equivalent to.
3. Show how you arrived at the percentage.

response.text:
1. The candidate meets 100% of the requirement.
2. An equivalent item was judged: MySQL is equivalent to PostgreSQL, which satisfies the "or similar databases" condition.
3. The requirement uses "or" ("PostgreSQL, Redis or similar databases"), meaning the candidate only needs to have experience with one of the listed databases or an equivalent one to fully meet the criteria. Since the candidate has experience with one equivalent database (MySQL), they satisfy 1 out of the 1 required conditions, resulting in 100%.
